[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="about-home"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="about-texts"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="about-text"][vc_custom_heading text="INDOOR GOLF LIKE NO OTHER IN MELBOURNE" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="WELCOME TO THE GOLF SANCTUARY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Welcome to Melbourne’s ultimate indoor golf experience — where cutting-edge technology, premium amenities, and an inviting atmosphere combine to create more than just a game. At The Golf Sanctuary, we’ve built a space that balances serious play with social enjoyment, offering everything from high-tech simulators to gourmet food and drinks in a luxurious, relaxed setting.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="btn"]

Located just off Dandenong Road, around the corner from Monash University, and directly across from M-City Shopping Centre, The Golf Sanctuary is designed for convenience. Whether it’s a casual drop-in, a night out with friends, or a corporate event, getting here is easy — and once you’re inside, you’ll quickly see why this isn’t just another golf studio.

READ MORE

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="play-img"][vc_column_inner el_class="img-play" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="2718" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="play-text" width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

MORE THAN JUST A GAME

The Golf Sanctuary isn’t your typical indoor golf course. It’s a destination where modern design, premium comfort, and advanced simulation technology converge seamlessly. From the moment you enter, you’re welcomed into a space that feels sophisticated yet inviting, with areas for relaxation, socialising, and immersive play.

For those who want to improve, our dedicated, state-of-the-art coaching and fitting space takes your practice beyond the simulator—featuring three cameras and two 42-inch touch-screen TVs that use multi-angles and interactive review that deliver clear feedback and faster progress, so you can play better and score lower.

Our state-of-the-art golf training simulator allows both beginners and seasoned golfers to refine their skills with precision, while still keeping the experience fun and accessible. Every swing, putt, and shot is designed to feel like the real thing, making your time here both effective and enjoyable. And beyond the game, the vibrant social spaces and thoughtful design encourage connection, conversation, and lasting memories.

READ MORE

PLAY YOUR WAY

Whether you're looking to improve your game or simply enjoy time with friends, The Golf Sanctuary gives you the flexibility to play how you want. Casual sessions are easy to book, while members can enjoy extended access and exclusive benefits. From simulator hire and coaching to club fitting and range sessions, our offerings are designed to suit all levels and interests.

With advanced tracking and performance feedback, dedicated golfers can work on their technique, while social players can relax and soak in the ambience. This is indoor golf reimagined — a place where serious training and enjoyable play coexist without pressure.

READ MORE

FOOD, DRINKS & SOCIAL SPACES

What sets The Golf Sanctuary apart is our full kitchen and premium beverage selection. Unlike other venues that offer only basic snacks, we provide a thoughtfully curated menu to complement your experience. From fresh, shareable plates to gourmet drinks, our food and beverage offerings transform a typical visit into a full social outing.

Enjoy a meal between rounds, toast with friends, or host a group event in style. Our spaces are designed for comfort and connection, making every visit a complete experience — not just a session on a simulator. Specialty cocktails, craft beers, and a rotating menu of chef-designed dishes ensure that every visit feels unique and indulgent.

READ MORE

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="home-img"][vc_single_image image="2712" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="about-home"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="about-texts"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="about-text"][vc_custom_heading text="CONFIDENCE IN EVERY CLUB" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="OFFICIAL TITLEIST PARTNER" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Our premium hire sets feature the latest Titleist GT family, including GT2 and GT3, alongside the T-Series iron range. With options suited to a wide range of golfers — from those new to the game through to experienced players — every guest can enjoy the performance and quality expected from Titleist. Around the greens, Vokey Design SM11 wedges provide exceptional spin, control and versatility across a range of lofts.

Every simulator bay at The Golf Sanctuary is also stocked with brand new Titleist Pro V1 golf balls. For us, using generic range balls simply didn’t align with the experience we wanted to create. We’ve built The Golf Sanctuary as a premium golf destination, and we believe the equipment our guests use should reflect that — which is why we’ve chosen Titleist from tee to green.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="home-img"][vc_single_image image="2374" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="range-row"][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

fun come together. Play world-class courses, host unforgettable events, and improve your game — all in one premium space.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="offer-text"][service_columns][/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="event-row"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="event-text"][vc_column_text css=""]

EVENTS

EVENTS & CORPORATE FUNCTIONS

Planning a private event or corporate function? Our penthouse area features five simulators, a private bar, darts, and comfortable seating arrangements — perfect for hosting memorable events in a premium environment. Whether it’s team-building, celebrations, or social gatherings, The Golf Sanctuary provides a unique setting that combines entertainment, networking, and luxury.

Our professional staff can assist with planning and catering, ensuring that every detail is handled. From intimate gatherings to large corporate events, we create experiences that leave a lasting impression.

While indoor golf has traditionally skewed toward young men, our space is perfect for women, families, groups, and corporate clients alike. Everyone is welcome to enjoy our inclusive, judgement-free environment, whether it’s your first swing or your hundredth round.

By combining high-tech equipment, professional instruction, and a comfortable social atmosphere, we’ve created a venue where all visitors feel at home while enjoying the excitement of indoor golf.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row member-home" css=".vc_custom_1779752955625{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 70px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="MEMBERSHIP & CASUAL PLAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]From casual bookings to full memberships, The Golf Sanctuary has options to suit your lifestyle. Casual sessions allow you to enjoy a flexible visit, while memberships unlock exclusive access, priority booking, and additional benefits. Combined with simulator hire, coaching, club fitting, and food and beverage options, membership is more than just convenience — it’s an enhanced experience.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces"][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="about-home"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="about-texts"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="about-text"][vc_custom_heading text="About" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="Welcome to
The Golf Sanctuary" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary is Melbourne's ultimate indoor golf experience – where cutting edge technology, premium facilities and an inviting and inclusive atmosphere combine to create the ultimate indoor golf experience. Here, we have built a venue that balances serious play with social enjoyment, offering everything from high-tech simulators and golf ranges to gourmet food and drink in a luxurious and relaxed setting

The Golf Sanctuary has been designed to be an inclusive and premier facility to host golfers of all abilities. Whether you are starting out or a seasoned professional, having a night out with friends, hosting a party or a corporate event, our team will accommodate all of your needs.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="play-img"][vc_column_inner el_class="img-play" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="2721" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="play-text" width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

Play, Practise or Compete Your Way

 

14 x sims

7 x range

2 x bars and 1 x full kitchen

Corporate entertainment

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="home-img"][vc_single_image image="2741" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="about-home"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="about-texts"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="about-text"][vc_custom_heading text="Find What Fits Your Game" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="The Golf Sanctuary x Titleist" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]

The Golf Sanctuary is proud to partner with Titleist, bringing premium, tour-proven equipment directly into our bays.

Every simulator is stocked with Titleist Pro V1 golf balls, while our premium hire sets feature the latest Titleist GT driver family, including GT2 and GT3, alongside the T-Series iron range — giving golfers of all levels access to some of the best-performing equipment in the game.

Around the greens, Vokey Design SM11 wedges deliver exceptional spin, control and versatility, allowing both members and casual players to experience the performance and precision trusted at the highest level of the game.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="home-img"][vc_single_image image="2742" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="course-rowsss" css=".vc_custom_1779260463182{margin-top: 50px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1023" img_size="" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Built For Modern Golfers" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Today’s golfers want more than a traditional range experience.

They want flexibility, smarter training options, immersive gameplay, and a comfortable environment that makes every session enjoyable.

The Golf Sanctuary combines premium indoor golf facilities with advanced simulator technology to deliver a realistic and engaging playing experience. From casual rounds on world-class virtual courses to focused skill development sessions, every bay is designed to provide a high-quality experience.

Our venue creates a seamless balance between performance and enjoyment—giving players the opportunity to improve while still embracing everything that makes golf fun.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="More Than Just a Simulator Venue" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary was built with community at its core.

Golf has always been about more than the scorecard. It’s about connection, shared experiences, competition, and enjoying time with like-minded people.

That’s why we’ve created a venue that brings golfers together.

Through leagues, memberships, events, and casual bookings, we offer an environment where beginners feel welcome, experienced players feel challenged, and everyone feels part of something bigger than just a practice session.

Whether you’re joining us for a quick hit, a competitive league night, or a regular weekly session, The Golf Sanctuary is designed to be a place people want to return to.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1021" img_size="" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1023" img_size="" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Experience Golf Differently" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary offers a fresh way to enjoy the game—one that blends technology, premium facilities, flexibility, and a genuine social atmosphere.

No weather limitations. No rushed range sessions. No compromises.

Just a smarter, more enjoyable way to play.

Book a session, explore our memberships, or join our growing golf community today.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="start-img about-start" css=".vc_custom_1779260525712{margin-top: 50px !important;margin-bottom: 50px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_widget_sidebar sidebar_id="Start"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="leagues-row about-leagues"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Leagues" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="Join the Competition" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Our leagues combine friendly competition with social fun, making golf more engaging and rewarding.[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner el_class="leagues-text"][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="130" img_size="full" onclick="custom_link" css="" link="https://wordpress-1632668-6711886.cloudwaysapps.com/league-nights-team-of-1/"][vc_column_text css=""]

Designed for fun, engagement, and excitement, our venue combines world-class simulators, premium food and drinks, and a vibrant atmosphere to create the perfect birthday experience for guests of all ages. Whether it’s a kids’ party, a teen celebration, or a family gathering, The Golf Sanctuary provides a unique space where everyone can play, socialise, and enjoy.

Conveniently located just off Dandenong Road, around the corner from Monash University, and directly across from M-City Shopping Centre, our venue is easy to reach from anywhere in Melbourne. With flexible scheduling and fully equipped party spaces, hosting a birthday party has never been simpler — or more fun.

Club hire is included with all event bookings, giving your guests everything they need to step in, play, and enjoy the experience—regardless of golfing ability.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

It’s a premium experience that blends high-tech entertainment, comfort, and hospitality. Guests can enjoy multiple simulators, lounge areas with plush seating, and a curated menu of delicious food and drinks designed to keep everyone fuelled and happy.

Our event coordinators can assist with all the details, from party setup to customised catering, ensuring your celebration is seamless and memorable. Whether the focus is competitive play, casual fun, or a mix of both, our space is designed to accommodate your vision.
[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Young guests can enjoy their first swing on our simulators, while teens and adults can take on challenges and compete in friendly games. It’s a judgment-free environment where everyone can participate, have fun, and create memories together.

Food and drink are a central part of the experience. Our full kitchen prepares a variety of fresh and shareable dishes, while our beverage selection ensures adults and older teens can enjoy a sophisticated menu alongside classic favourites. From casual snacks to premium treats, the food and drink offering helps turn your party into a full social experience, not just an activity.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

  • Customised tournament or game formats
  • Food and beverage catering
  • Party decorations and themed extras
  • Optional add-ons like coaching, photo opportunities, and prizes

Each party is tailored to your needs, so you can focus on enjoying the celebration while we handle the details. Our flexible approach ensures that every indoor golf party feels personalised and special.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event hidden-item"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="WHY CHOOSE THE GOLF SANCTUARY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Choosing The Golf Sanctuary for your birthday means choosing a venue that stands out. Unlike traditional party venues, we offer:

  • A premium, modern indoor golf environment
  • Interactive and engaging activities for all guests
  • Exceptional food and drink options
  • Professional staff to manage every detail

The combination of immersive golf simulators, social spaces, and hospitality ensures that your guests leave with lasting memories and a desire to return for another visit.
[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Whether you’re celebrating a milestone birthday, hosting a family gathering, or simply looking for a fun way to mark the occasion, our venue provides the perfect backdrop for an indoor golf party that everyone will remember.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event hidden-item"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="BOOK NOW!" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Make your next celebration extraordinary at The Golf Sanctuary. Read More

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1558" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss hidden-item"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1459" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="A FRESH TAKE ON CHRISTMAS PARTIES" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]If you’re looking to move beyond the usual restaurant or function room, The Golf Sanctuary provides a refreshing alternative to a traditional Christmas party golf club setting by offering a more engaging way to celebrate, combining advanced golf simulators, premium indoor facilities, and a stylish social setting designed for festive events.

Guests can enjoy friendly competition, casual games, and interactive entertainment while still having plenty of space to relax, connect, and enjoy the atmosphere. It’s an ideal setup for teams, friendship groups, and end-of-year celebrations looking for something beyond the ordinary.

For groups wanting a more exclusive experience, The Penthouse offers a premium private event space designed specifically for memorable group celebrations.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Designed for premium group experiences, The Penthouse features:

  • Five Advanced Golf Simulators
  • Private Bar Access
  • Darts
  • Premium Lounge Seating
  • Dedicated Event Space for Socialising and Entertainment

Perfect for corporate teams, client events, or private celebrations, The Penthouse combines fun, competition, and exclusivity in one elevated environment.

Whether your guests want light-hearted games, simulator challenges, or simply a premium space to unwind and celebrate, The Penthouse creates an event atmosphere people will actually remember.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

Plan ​An Event

Our team can assist with event coordination, simulator experiences, and function planning to ensure your celebration runs smoothly from start to finish.

With premium facilities, interactive entertainment, and a welcoming atmosphere, hosting your end-of-year event has never been easier.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="start-img events-start"][vc_column][vc_widget_sidebar sidebar_id="Start"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event hidden-item laugh-row-top compete-rows"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="COMPETE FOR THE ULTIMATE PRIZE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Individual League at The Golf Sanctuary is designed for golfers who enjoy regular competition, structured weekly play, and the opportunity to earn prizes throughout the season. Running across four months, the league combines strategy, consistency, and competitive golf in a flexible simulator format. Whether you’re aiming to top the leaderboard or simply want a more engaging way to play regularly, the Individual League gives you a fresh challenge every week. Each week, our League Manager selects a new course to keep competition varied and exciting. Rounds are generally played from the second-from-back tees, while women compete from the second-from-front tees. Unlike traditional league nights, the Individual League is not locked to one specific night. Each competition round runs over the course of the week, allowing players to book and complete their round at a time that suits their schedule. The league uses a Stableford format, creating a fair competition system where players compete based on their TrackMan handicap. This ensures every participant has a genuine opportunity to perform well and earn points.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1461" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss hidden-item"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1460" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Top 16/8/4/2/1" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Before registering, make sure you:[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

  • Register in person at reception

  • Book weekly rounds throughout the season
  • Track your leaderboard progress each week
[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Leaderboard updates will be shared regularly via email and social media.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event hidden-item"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY WEEK" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]No two weeks are the same. With a new course selected each round, players are consistently challenged across different layouts, shot requirements, and playing conditions. Using premium TrackMan simulators, every shot is measured with exceptional accuracy, allowing players to track progress while enjoying a highly realistic simulator golf experience. The Individual League is open to an unlimited number of participants, creating a dynamic competition environment while maintaining a fair handicap-based format. Whether you're highly competitive or simply enjoy regular structured play, the league offers an engaging weekly golf experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1455" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner disable_element="yes" el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1143" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="CONDITIONS OF ENTRY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]To participate in the Individual League, players must:
  • Hold an active TrackMan Handicap
  • Have completed a minimum of three 18-hole rounds recorded in the TrackMan system
Each participant is also required to:
  • Pay a $50 nomination fee
  • Pay bay hire for each tournament round played
As this is an individual competition, no team name is required. Players compete under their own name throughout the season leaderboard. These entry conditions help ensure fair competition and a smooth league experience for all participants.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss hidden-item"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1228" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="WHY JOIN THE INDIVIDUAL LEAGUE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Individual League offers more than just weekly simulator golf. It provides a structured, competitive way to play consistently, improve your game, and stay engaged over an extended season. Benefits include:
  • Weekly competition in a flexible format
  • Handicap-based scoring for fair play
  • New courses and challenges each week
  • Season-long leaderboard tracking
  • Finals qualification and prizes
  • Social and competitive golf environment
With unlimited participant spots available, players can join the league and compete at their own pace within each weekly round window. If you're looking for a more engaging way to play regularly, the Individual League delivers structure, competition, and something to look forward to every week.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="course-rowsss indo"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1147" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="LOCK IN YOUR SEASON SPOT TODAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Individual League is structured, flexible, and built for players who enjoy regular competition. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="2747" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss indo"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="2763" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="LOCK IN YOUR TEAM BEFORE IT’S FULL" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Get your two-player team together, lock in your team name, and secure your place before the season begins.

Don’t miss your opportunity to compete.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

SECURE YOUR SPOT TODAY

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="start-img events-start"][vc_column][vc_widget_sidebar sidebar_id="Start"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row disable_element="yes" el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="GETTING STARTED" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]To enter the League of Two Teams, all players must:

  • Hold an active TrackMan Handicap
  • Have completed a minimum of three 18-hole rounds recorded in the TrackMan system

Each team must:

  • Consist of two eligible players
  • Register a team name for the season leaderboard

Pricing:

  • $200 team entry fee for the season
  • $20 per player, per week for simulator hire

This gives players access to organised weekly competition, premium simulator facilities, and a full season of structured play.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1153" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row disable_element="yes" el_class="lessons-row lessons-event checks two-leagues-summary"][vc_column el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="IN SUMMARY" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="make-uls"]

  • Before registering, make sure you:
    • • Form your team of 2 players
    • • Hold active TrackMan Handicaps
    • • Complete a minimum of 3 x 18-hole TrackMan rounds
    • • Choose your team name
    • • Pay your team entry fee
    • • Get ready for weekly competition
  • Pricing:
      • • $200 per team for the season
      • • $20 per player, per week for simulator hire
      • All players will receive weekly fixtures, updates, and results directly.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row disable_element="yes" el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="WEEKLY SIMULATOR GOLF, TEAM RIVALRY & SOCIAL VIBES ALL IN ONE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The League of Two Teams at The Golf Sanctuary is built for golfers who enjoy structured competition, regular weekly play, and a strong social atmosphere.

Designed for players who want more than the occasional round, this simulator golf league combines weekly matchups, team strategy, and season-long leaderboard competition in a premium indoor setting.

Played across an 11-week season using advanced TrackMan technology, the league delivers the precision of simulator golf with the added excitement of team rivalry. Whether you're aiming for the top of the ladder or simply looking for a consistent weekly golf commitment with a mate, this format delivers a competitive and engaging experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="397" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="873" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="HOW THE LEAGUE WORKS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Each team consists of two players, with a total of 10 teams competing across the season.

Every week, teams go head-to-head in a structured matchup, with players competing against their equivalent opponent.

All matches are played using a stroke (nett) format, allowing golfers of different skill levels to compete fairly using their TrackMan handicap.

Teams are awarded:

  • 4 points for a win
  • 2 points for a draw

A bonus is also awarded for teams who win both matchups in a given round.

As points accumulate across the season, the leaderboard evolves and competition intensifies.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row disable_element="yes" el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="THE ROAD TO FINALS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]After nine weeks of regular competition, the top four teams progress to the finals series.

Finals are structured as follows:

  • 1st place vs 4th place
  • 2nd place vs 3rd place

Semi-final winners progress to the grand final, while remaining teams compete for third place.

This format rewards consistency throughout the season while still creating exciting finals opportunities.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="877" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner disable_element="yes" el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1152" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="WHAT TO EXPECT EACH WEEK" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Each week features a new course and fresh playing conditions, keeping gameplay varied, strategic, and engaging.

From iconic championship layouts to more tactical course designs, every round tests a different part of your game.

All matches are played on premium TrackMan simulators, delivering accurate ball tracking and a highly realistic simulator experience.

Standard tee positions apply:

  • Men: second-from-back tees
  • Women: second-from-front tees

League nights are designed to combine competition with a strong social atmosphere, making them something players genuinely look forward to each week.

Food and drinks are available during league sessions, with our popular pizza and schooner deal available before 8pm.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1156" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="WHY JOIN LEAGUE NIGHT" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The League of Two Teams offers more than just weekly golf.

It provides a structured and enjoyable way to:

  • play consistently
  • improve your game
  • compete alongside a teammate
  • enjoy a social weekly environment

Benefits include:

  • Weekly structured competition
  • Handicap-based fair play
  • Season-long leaderboard tracking
  • Finals qualification
  • Social and competitive atmosphere

With only 10 team spots available, the league remains organised, competitive, and highly engaging throughout the season.

If you’ve already got your playing partner sorted, now’s the time to secure your place.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="start-img events-start"][vc_column][vc_widget_sidebar sidebar_id="Start"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="A GOLF EXPERIENCE JUST FOR WOMEN" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Ladies’ Sip ‘n’ Swing at The Golf Sanctuary is a relaxed, social gathering designed for women who want to enjoy golf, learn a few tips, and share a fun night with friends. Unlike structured leagues, this event is all about social interaction, friendly competition, and enjoying a few glasses of champagne or prosecco while improving your game.

Hosted by PGA Member Mai Julius, participants receive expert guidance in a private penthouse setting, away from the public areas. Mai will provide individual feedback and tips throughout the evening, helping attendees refine their swings while keeping the focus on fun.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1558" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1459" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="SOCIAL GAMES & PRIZES" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The evening is packed with interactive games and challenges designed to engage all skill levels. Each game offers a chance to win prizes, so whether you’re a beginner or an experienced golfer, there’s something to make the night exciting. With each ticket including two glasses of champagne or prosecco, the atmosphere is relaxed and celebratory.

The penthouse venue ensures privacy and comfort, making it a perfect space to mingle with friends, meet other female golfers, and enjoy a premium, social experience. The combination of expert instruction, games, and refreshments makes Ladies’ Sip ‘n’ Swing a unique way to enjoy golf in a fun and friendly environment.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="LEARN FROM A PRO" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Mai Julius, a female PGA professional, will guide the evening. From swing adjustments to game strategies, she’ll provide personalised feedback to help each participant improve while keeping the experience lighthearted and social. Her guidance ensures every swing, putt, and challenge counts, even in this relaxed format.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1461" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil checks laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text"][vc_custom_heading text="HOW TO JOIN" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="book-ul"]

  • Book your ticket – Reserve your spot for the evening event.
  • Enjoy the included drinks – Each ticket comes with two glasses of champagne or prosecco.
  • Participate in games – Take part in fun golf challenges designed for all skill levels.
  • Receive tips from Mai Julius – Get personalised feedback from a PGA professional.
  • Win prizes – Prizes will be awarded for games throughout the evening.
  • Relax and socialise – Enjoy the private penthouse setting with friends and other female golfers.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="MAKE YOUR EVENING SPECIAL" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Ladies’ Sip ‘n’ Swing is more than golf; it’s a night out to connect, have fun, and celebrate the game with other women. Spaces are limited, so secure your spot now and get ready for a fun, relaxed, and interactive golf evening.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss rowsss-less rowsss-lesssss laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column][vc_row_inner disable_element="yes" el_class="lessons-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="lessons-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="POWERED BY ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]At The Golf Sanctuary, our lessons are supported by industry-leading simulator technology that provides real-time feedback on every shot. From ball flight to club path and spin rate, you’ll gain valuable insights into your performance with each swing.

To take your improvement even further, we also offer a state-of-the-art fitting and coaching room featuring three cameras and two 42-inch touch-screen TVs. This set-up allows for in-depth swing review and clear side-by-side comparisons, helping you understand what to change, why it matters, and how to apply it—so you can get on track to lower your scores faster.

This data-driven approach removes guesswork and allows both you and your coach to make informed adjustments. Combined with visual feedback and guided instruction, it creates a powerful learning environment where progress is measurable and consistent.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="926" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="lessons-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="lessons-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="COACHED BY DATA, GUIDED BY EXPERTISE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]

At The Golf Sanctuary, every lesson is powered by Trackman, the world's most trusted launch monitor technology. From the moment you step in, Trackman captures real-time data on every shot, measuring key metrics like club path, face angle, ball speed, launch angle, and spin rate.

This data gives your coach a precise, objective picture of your swing — removing guesswork and replacing it with clear, actionable feedback. Combined with our dedicated room to lessons/fittings that feature three cameras and two 42-inch touchscreen TVs, you can see your swing from every angle and understand exactly what needs to change and why.

The result is a learning environment where your progress is visible, measurable, and consistent from session to session.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="2763" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner disable_element="yes" el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="838" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="DEDICATED ROOM TO LESSONS/FITTINGS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]

  • 60 mins - $150
  • 30 mins - $80
  • TPI Qualified Level 1 and 2
  • Trackman Certified Level 1 and 2

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

BOOK A SESSION

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="2749" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="MEET YOUR COACH" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]

Cameron, Managing Director of The Golf Sanctuary, is a PGA member holding an Advanced Coaching Diploma, among the highest coaching qualifications awarded by the PGA of Australia. His Trackman Level 1 and Level 2 accreditations mean he doesn't just use the data; he understands it deeply and knows how to apply it to your game.

What sets Cameron apart is his Titleist Performance Institute (TPI) accreditation at both Level 1 and Level 2. TPI allows Cameron to assess how your body moves and identify physical tendencies or limitations before you've even hit a ball. This means your lesson is personalised from the very first minute.

  • PGA Member – Advanced Coaching Diploma
  • Trackman Accredited Level 1 and 2
  • TPI Accredited Level 1 and 2
  • 60 mins – $150
  • 30 mins – $80

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

BOOK A SESSION

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="course-rowsss" css=".vc_custom_1779341909375{margin-top: 50px !important;margin-bottom: 50px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="lessons-row Philosophy-coac"][vc_column_inner el_class="lessons-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="FLEXIBLE SESSION OPTIONS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]We offer flexible lesson durations to suit your schedule and goals, whether you’re after a quick tune-up or a more in-depth session.

  • Short sessions for focused improvements
  • Longer sessions for detailed coaching and analysis
  • Ongoing lesson plans for consistent development

This flexibility ensures that your lessons fit seamlessly into your routine, making it easier to stay committed and see results.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

ENQUIRE NOW

Whether you're brand new to golf or working to sharpen a specific part of your game, Cameron tailors every lesson to your goals, your schedule, and how your body moves. No two golfers are the same — and no two lessons should be either.

Sessions are available in flexible durations to suit your availability, with ongoing lesson plans available for those committed to consistent improvement. Because your Trackman data is tracked across visits, Cameron can measure your progress objectively and ensure every session builds on the last.

Whether you’re working through challenges or building new skills, our venue is designed to help you feel comfortable and confident throughout the process.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="lessons-row Philosophy-coacs"][vc_column_inner el_class="lessons-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="START YOUR JOURNEY TODAY!" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Our indoor golf lessons are part of a broader experience that combines coaching, technology, and lifestyle. This holistic approach ensures that learning golf isn’t just about improvement — it’s about enjoyment, connection, and long-term involvement.

If you’re ready to improve your game in a way that feels modern, engaging, and effective, The Golf Sanctuary is here to help. Book your session today and experience how indoor golf lessons can transform the way you learn, practise, and enjoy the game.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="THE PLACE TO BE FOR INDOOR GOLF ENTHUSIASTS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""][acf_post_title] golfers looking for the ultimate indoor golf experience will find it at The Golf Sanctuary! It's where cutting-edge technology, premium amenities, and an inviting atmosphere combine to create more than just a game. The Golf Sanctuary is built in a space that balances serious play with social enjoyment, offering everything from high-tech simulators to gourmet food and drinks in a luxurious, relaxed setting. Located just off Dandenong Road, around the corner from Monash University, and directly across from M-City Shopping Centre, The Golf Sanctuary is designed for convenience. Whether it's a casual drop-in, a night out with friends, or a corporate event, getting here is easy. Once you're inside, you'll quickly see why this isn't just another golf studio.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
BOOK YOUR BAY NOW
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1558" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1459" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="MORE THAN JUST A GAME" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary isn't your typical indoor golf venue. It's a destination where modern design, premium comfort, and advanced simulation technology converge seamlessly. From the moment you enter, you're welcomed into a space that feels sophisticated yet inviting, with areas for relaxation, socialising, and immersive play. Our state-of-the-art indoor golf simulators give [acf_post_title] beginners and seasoned golfers alike the chance to refine their skills with precision, while still keeping the experience fun and accessible. Every swing, putt, and shot is designed to feel like the real thing, making your time here both effective and enjoyable. And beyond the game, the vibrant social spaces and thoughtful design encourage connection, conversation, and lasting memories.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="start-img about-start"][vc_column][vc_widget_sidebar sidebar_id="Start"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="PLAY YOUR WAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Whether you're looking to improve your game or simply enjoy time with friends, The Golf Sanctuary gives you the flexibility to play how you want. Casual sessions are easy to book, while members can enjoy extended access and exclusive benefits. From simulator hire and coaching to club fitting and range sessions, our offerings are designed to suit all levels and interests. With advanced tracking and performance feedback, dedicated golfers can work on their technique, while social players can relax and soak in the ambience. For golfers in [acf_post_title], this is the indoor golf experience you've been waiting for — a place where serious training and enjoyable play coexist without pressure.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
BOOK YOUR BAY NOW
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1461" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row Philosophy-coac flex food-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1465" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="FOOD, DRINKS & SOCIAL SPACES" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]What sets The Golf Sanctuary apart is our full kitchen and premium beverage selection. Unlike other venues that offer only basic snacks, we provide a thoughtfully curated menu to complement your experience. From fresh, shareable plates to premium drinks, our food and beverage offering brings people together and makes every visit feel like a complete social experience. Enjoy a meal between rounds, toast with friends, or host a group event in style. Our spaces are designed for comfort and connection, making every visit a complete experience for our [acf_post_title] clients — not just a session on a golf simulator. Specialty cocktails, craft beers, and a rotating menu of delectable dishes ensure that every visit feels unique and indulgent.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows Philosophy-coac laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="EVENTS & CORPORATE FUNCTIONS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Planning a private event or corporate function? Our penthouse area features five simulators, a private bar, darts, and comfortable seating arrangements — perfect for hosting memorable events in a premium environment. Whether it's team-building, celebrations, or social gatherings, The Golf Sanctuary provides a unique setting that combines entertainment, networking, and luxury. Our professional staff can assist with planning and catering, ensuring that every detail is handled. From intimate gatherings to large corporate events, we create experiences that leave a lasting impression for guests travelling from [acf_post_title] and surrounds.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
PLAN YOUR EVENT
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1389" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex laugh-row-top food-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1395" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="INCLUSIVE, WELCOMING & DESIGNED FOR ALL" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary is intentionally designed to appeal to a wide audience. While indoor golf in and around [acf_post_title] has traditionally skewed toward young men, our space is perfect for women, families, groups, and corporate clients alike. Everyone is welcome to enjoy our inclusive, judgement-free environment, whether it's your first swing or your hundredth round. By combining high-tech equipment, professional instruction, and a comfortable social atmosphere, we've created a venue where all visitors feel at home while enjoying the excitement of indoor golf.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows Philosophy-coac laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="MEMBERSHIP & CASUAL PLAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]From casual bookings to full memberships, The Golf Sanctuary has options to suit your lifestyle. Casual sessions allow you to enjoy a flexible visit, while memberships unlock exclusive access, priority booking, and additional benefits. Combined with simulator hire, coaching, club fitting, and food and beverage options, membership is more than just convenience — it's an enhanced experience for [acf_post_title] golfers.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
BE A MEMBER
VIEW MEMBERSHIPS
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1398" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex laugh-row-top food-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1399" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="EXPERIENCE INDOOR GOLF DIFFERENTLY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]At The Golf Sanctuary, indoor golf is more than just an alternative to the outdoors — it's a premium experience in its own right. With world-class facilities, gourmet food and drinks, advanced simulators, and a welcoming atmosphere, we invite [acf_post_title] locals to discover a new way to play, relax, and connect in Melbourne. Whether you're coming for a serious practice session, a social night with friends, or a full evening of indulgence, The Golf Sanctuary transforms every visit into an experience worth remembering.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]

item.dc:creator: TheGolfSanctuary_Admin
item.content:encoded:
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="faqss"][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="What we Offer" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="Frequently Asked Questions" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:center" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css="" el_class="blop-p"]Whether you’re new to the game or simply exploring a different way to play, it’s natural to have a few questions. At The Golf Sanctuary, we’ve created a modern indoor golf experience designed to be accessible, enjoyable, and easy to understand—so here are the answers to some of the most common things people ask before getting started.[/vc_column_text][vc_toggle title="HOW DOES INDOOR GOLF WORK?" css=""]Indoor golf uses advanced simulator technology to recreate the feel of playing on a real course. Players hit premium golf balls into a screen and the Trackman hardware captures 40 different data points at thousands of frames per second to provide the most accurate information back to the player.
Suitable for all skill levels, indoor golf allows you to play full rounds, practise specific shots, or take part in coaching sessions. Thanks to the controlled indoor environment, you can enjoy a consistent, immersive golf experience year-round—no matter the weather. [/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="ARE INDOOR GOLF SIMULATORS ACCURATE?" css="" el_class="faqssss"]Modern indoor golf simulators are highly accurate, especially when using advanced systems like TrackMan technology. By combining radar and high‑speed cameras, these simulators capture detailed data on swing and ball flight, allowing distances, shot shape, and ball behaviour to closely mirror real‑world conditions.
At The Golf Sanctuary, this accuracy means players can trust the feedback they receive. Experienced golfers can analyse their performance and refine their game, while beginners gain a clear, easy way to see how different swings affect the ball—one of the key reasons indoor golf continues to grow in popularity.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="WHAT TO WEAR IN INDOOR GOLF" css="" el_class="faqssss"] One of the advantages of indoor golf is its flexibility when it comes to dress code. Unlike traditional golf courses, there’s no strict requirement for collared shirts or specific attire.
At The Golf Sanctuary, we recommend wearing comfortable, casual clothing that allows for a full range of motion. Activewear, golf polos, t-shirts, and comfortable pants or shorts are all suitable options.
Footwear is also flexible — while golf shoes can be worn, clean sneakers are perfectly acceptable and often more convenient.
Because the environment is climate-controlled, you don’t need to worry about weather conditions. This means you can focus on your game and enjoy the experience without the usual considerations of outdoor golf.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="HOW TO IMPROVE YOUR GOLF SWING" css="" el_class="faqssss"] Improving your golf swing comes down to a combination of practice, feedback, and consistency. One of the most effective ways to develop your technique is by using a simulator environment where every shot provides measurable data.
At The Golf Sanctuary, players have access to detailed swing analysis and professional coaching, making it easier to identify areas for improvement. By understanding factors like club path, face angle, and ball speed, you can make targeted adjustments that lead to real progress.
Regular practice is also key. Short, consistent sessions are often more effective than occasional long ones, as they help build muscle memory and reinforce good habits.
For those looking to accelerate their improvement, lessons with a PGA professional can provide structured guidance and personalised feedback. Combined with simulator technology, this creates a powerful learning environment that supports steady and lasting progress.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="STILL HAVE QUESTIONS?" css=""]If you’d like to learn more about how The Golf Sanctuary works or need help planning your visit, our team is here to assist. Whether you’re booking your first session, organising an event, or exploring membership options, we’re happy to guide you every step of the way.
Get in touch today or book your session to experience indoor golf in a welcoming, modern setting.[/vc_toggle][/vc_column][/vc_row]

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="INDOOR GOLF SIMULATOR" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="A Smarter, More Social Way to Experience the Game" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Experience the future of golf with an indoor golf simulator at The Golf Sanctuary. Designed to bring together cutting-edge technology, premium surroundings, and a relaxed social atmosphere, our venue offers a modern alternative to traditional golf. Whether you're looking to improve your game, enjoy time with friends, or simply try something new, The Golf Sanctuary delivers an experience that is both engaging and accessible.

Conveniently located just off Dandenong Road near Monash University and directly across from M-City Shopping Centre, we’ve created a space where golf fits seamlessly into your lifestyle — no matter your schedule or skill level.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1558" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1459" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="WHERE TECHNOLOGY MEETS REAL PLAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]At The Golf Sanctuary, we use industry-leading TrackMan technology to deliver a highly accurate and immersive experience. Every shot is tracked in real time, providing detailed data on ball speed, launch angle, spin, and direction.

This precision allows players to experience golf in a way that closely mirrors real-world conditions. Whether you're playing a full round or focusing on specific aspects of your swing, the technology ensures every session is both realistic and rewarding.

For those searching for an “indoor golf near me” option that offers more than just entertainment, The Golf Sanctuary provides a performance-driven environment without sacrificing comfort or enjoyment.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="A MODERN INDOOR GOLF CLUB EXPERIENCE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary isn’t just a simulator venue — it’s a complete indoor golf club designed for today’s players. We’ve reimagined the traditional golf setting by combining high-end simulators with a premium social space that encourages connection and relaxation.

Our venue features:

  • Spacious simulator bays for individual and group play
  • Lounge-style seating for a comfortable, social atmosphere
  • A full food and beverage offering
  • A welcoming environment for players of all levels

This blend of golf and hospitality creates an experience that feels elevated, whether you’re visiting for a casual session or a special occasion.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1461" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1465" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="PLAY, PRACTISE, AND IMPROVE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]One of the biggest advantages of indoor golf is the ability to play and practise in a consistent, controlled environment. With no weather disruptions and reliable conditions, you can focus entirely on your game.

Our indoor golf simulator setup allows you to:

  • Practise with real-time feedback
  • Play world-class courses from around the globe

[vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="THE BEST VENUE FOR A WORK CHRISTMAS PARTY MELBOURNE WILL LOVE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]A work Christmas party in Melbourne should feel like a genuine reward for your team, not just another obligation on the calendar. At The Golf Sanctuary, businesses can step into a premium indoor venue that blends entertainment, comfort, and connection into one seamless experience. It’s a setting designed to help teams unwind while still keeping the energy high.

Instead of the usual dinner or function room setup, this experience invites participation. With TrackMan simulators and a relaxed lounge atmosphere, your team can engage in a way that feels natural and enjoyable. It’s this shift away from tradition that makes celebrations here feel more memorable from the moment they begin.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1558" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1459" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="BUILT FOR TEAMS THAT WANT SOMETHING DIFFERENT" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Not every team wants the same kind of event, and that’s where flexibility becomes essential. The Golf Sanctuary offers a dynamic space where guests can move between playing, socialising, and relaxing without being locked into a rigid schedule. This freedom helps create a more organic and enjoyable atmosphere for everyone involved.

Whether your group is competitive or just there to have fun, the experience adapts. It’s ideal for teams that want to break away from predictable formats and explore something more engaging. For companies searching for work Christmas party packages that feel fresh and modern, this approach delivers something far more exciting.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="PREMIUM ENTERTAINMENT THAT EVERYONE CAN ENJOY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary combines high-end technology with an inclusive environment, ensuring every guest feels comfortable getting involved. TrackMan simulators provide realistic gameplay and instant feedback, allowing both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the experience without pressure.

Beyond the simulators, the venue’s layout supports a social and relaxed vibe. Comfortable seating, food and beverage options, and well-designed spaces create an environment where guests can connect just as easily off the screen as they do on it. This balance is what turns a standard event into something far more engaging.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1461" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1465" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="FLEXIBLE OPTIONS TO MATCH YOUR EVENT STYLE" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Planning a Christmas party should be straightforward, and The Golf Sanctuary makes it easy to tailor your event. From smaller team gatherings to larger corporate functions, the space can be adapted to suit your group size and preferences. Every detail is designed to make hosting simple and stress-free.

With a range of Christmas party packages available, businesses can choose an option that aligns with their goals and budget. Whether you’re after a casual celebration or a more structured event, the flexibility ensures your team gets exactly what they need from the experience.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="WHERE EXPERIENCES CREATE LASTING IMPACT" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The best events are the ones people continue talking about long after they’re over. At The Golf Sanctuary, every element is designed to create those moments — from shared laughs during gameplay to relaxed conversations between rounds. It’s an environment that naturally brings people together.

Right in the middle of the festive season, choosing the right venue for a work Christmas party in Melbourne can elevate your entire event. Instead of simply hosting a function, you’re creating an experience that reflects your team culture and leaves a lasting impression.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="1398" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss indo"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1397" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="END THE YEAR WITH SOMETHING WORTH REMEMBERING" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]As the year wraps up, your Christmas party becomes an opportunity to celebrate achievements and strengthen team connections. The Golf Sanctuary offers a modern alternative to traditional venues, giving businesses a space where entertainment and interaction come together effortlessly.

If you’re looking to host a standout work Christmas party in Melbourne, this is where premium experiences meet genuine connection. It’s the kind of celebration that not only ends the year on a high but sets the tone for what’s ahead.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row disable_element="yes" el_class="lessons-row lessons-event"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-text"][vc_custom_heading text="EFFORTLESS PLANNING, SEAMLESS EXECUTION" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Organising a Christmas function doesn’t have to be stressful. Our experienced team works with you to ensure every detail is handled, from initial planning through to the event itself.

We offer flexible packages and tailored options to suit your goals, making it easy to create a celebration that aligns with your vision. Whether you know exactly what you want or need guidance along the way, we’re here to help bring it all together.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="lessons-img"][vc_single_image image="795" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="course-rowsss indo"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="797" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="SECURE YOUR CHRISTMAS PARTY VENUE TODAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]If you’re looking for a Christmas party venue that offers more than the usual, The Golf Sanctuary is ready to deliver. With a unique blend of interactive entertainment and premium hospitality, we provide a space where celebrations feel effortless and memorable.

Enquire today and discover how The Golf Sanctuary can become your go-to venue for any unforgettable event, whatever the season and reason may be.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]
