[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="THE PLACE TO BE FOR INDOOR GOLF SIMULATOR ENTHUSIASTS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""][acf_post_title] golfers looking for the ultimate indoor golf simulator experience will find it at The Golf Sanctuary! It's where cutting-edge technology, premium amenities, and an inviting atmosphere combine to create more than just a game. The Golf Sanctuary is built in a space that balances serious play with social enjoyment, offering everything from high-tech simulators to gourmet food and drinks in a luxurious, relaxed setting. Located just off Dandenong Road, around the corner from Monash University, and directly across from M-City Shopping Centre, The Golf Sanctuary is designed for convenience. Whether it's a casual drop-in, a night out with friends, or a corporate event, getting here is easy. Once you're inside, you'll quickly see why this isn't just another golf studio.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
BOOK YOUR BAY NOW
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1558" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex phil laugh-row-top"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1459" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="MORE THAN JUST A GAME" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary isn't your typical indoor golf venue. It's a destination where modern design, premium comfort, and advanced simulation technology converge seamlessly. From the moment you enter, you're welcomed into a space that feels sophisticated yet inviting, with areas for relaxation, socialising, and immersive play. Our state-of-the-art indoor golf simulator gives [acf_post_title] beginners and seasoned golfers alike the chance to refine their skills with precision, while still keeping the experience fun and accessible. Every swing, putt, and shot is designed to feel like the real thing, making your time here both effective and enjoyable. And beyond the game, the vibrant social spaces and thoughtful design encourage connection, conversation, and lasting memories.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" disable_element="yes" el_class="start-img about-start"][vc_column][vc_widget_sidebar sidebar_id="Start"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="PLAY YOUR WAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Whether you're looking to improve your game or simply enjoy time with friends, The Golf Sanctuary gives you the flexibility to play how you want. Casual sessions are easy to book, while members can enjoy extended access and exclusive benefits. From simulator hire and coaching to club fitting and range sessions, our offerings are designed to suit all levels and interests. With advanced tracking and performance feedback, dedicated golfers can work on their technique, while social players can relax and soak in the ambience. For golfers in [acf_post_title], this is the indoor golf experience you've been waiting for — a place where serious training and enjoyable play coexist without pressure.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
BOOK YOUR BAY NOW
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1461" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row Philosophy-coac flex food-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1465" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="FOOD, DRINKS & SOCIAL SPACES" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""] What sets The Golf Sanctuary apart is our full kitchen and premium beverage selection. Unlike other venues that offer only basic snacks, we provide a thoughtfully curated menu to complement your experience. From fresh, shareable plates to premium drinks, our food and beverage offering brings people together and makes every visit feel like a complete social experience. Enjoy a meal between rounds, toast with friends, or host a group event in style. Our spaces are designed for comfort and connection, making every visit a complete experience for our [acf_post_title] clients — not just a session on a golf simulator. Specialty cocktails, craft beers, and a rotating menu of delectable dishes ensure that every visit feels unique and indulgent.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows Philosophy-coac laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="EVENTS & CORPORATE FUNCTIONS" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Planning a private event or corporate function? Our penthouse area features five simulators, a private bar, darts, and comfortable seating arrangements — perfect for hosting memorable events in a premium environment. Whether it's team-building, celebrations, or social gatherings, The Golf Sanctuary provides a unique setting that combines entertainment, networking, and luxury. Our professional staff can assist with planning and catering, ensuring that every detail is handled. From intimate gatherings to large corporate events, we create experiences that leave a lasting impression for guests travelling from [acf_post_title] and surrounds.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
PLAN YOUR EVENT
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1389" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex laugh-row-top food-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1395" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="INCLUSIVE, WELCOMING & DESIGNED FOR ALL" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]The Golf Sanctuary is intentionally designed to appeal to a wide audience. While indoor golf in and around [acf_post_title] has traditionally skewed toward young men, our space is perfect for women, families, groups, and corporate clients alike. Everyone is welcome to enjoy our inclusive, judgement-free environment, whether it's your first swing or your hundredth round. By combining high-tech equipment, professional instruction, and a comfortable social atmosphere, we've created a venue where all visitors feel at home while enjoying the excitement of indoor golf.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="course-rowsss"][vc_column][vc_row_inner el_class="course-rows Philosophy-coac laugh-row-gaps"][vc_column_inner el_class="course-texts" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="MEMBERSHIP & CASUAL PLAY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]From casual bookings to full memberships, The Golf Sanctuary has options to suit your lifestyle. Casual sessions allow you to enjoy a flexible visit, while memberships unlock exclusive access, priority booking, and additional benefits. Combined with simulator hire, coaching, club fitting, and food and beverage options, membership is more than just convenience — it's an enhanced experience for [acf_post_title] golfers.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
BE A MEMBER
VIEW MEMBERSHIPS
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="course-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1398" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="Philosophy-row flex laugh-row-top food-row"][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-img" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="1399" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="Philosophy-text" width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="EXPERIENCE INDOOR GOLF DIFFERENTLY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]At The Golf Sanctuary, indoor golf is more than just an alternative to the outdoors — it's a premium experience in its own right. With world-class facilities, gourmet food and drinks, advanced simulators, and a welcoming atmosphere, we invite [acf_post_title] locals to discover a new way to play, relax, and connect in Melbourne. Whether you're coming for a serious practice session, a social night with friends, or a full evening of indulgence, The Golf Sanctuary transforms every visit into an experience worth remembering.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]
BOOK NOW
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

item.content:encoded:
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="about-home"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="about-texts"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="about-text"][vc_custom_heading text="INDOOR GOLF LIKE NO OTHER IN MELBOURNE" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="WELCOME TO THE GOLF SANCTUARY" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Welcome to Melbourne’s ultimate indoor golf experience — where cutting-edge technology, premium amenities, and an inviting atmosphere combine to create more than just a game. At The Golf Sanctuary, we’ve built a space that balances serious play with social enjoyment, offering everything from high-tech simulators to gourmet food and drinks in a luxurious, relaxed setting.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" el_class="btn"]

Located just off Dandenong Road, around the corner from Monash University, and directly across from M-City Shopping Centre, The Golf Sanctuary is designed for convenience. Whether it’s a casual drop-in, a night out with friends, or a corporate event, getting here is easy — and once you’re inside, you’ll quickly see why this isn’t just another golf studio.

READ MORE

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="play-img"][vc_column_inner el_class="img-play" width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="2718" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="play-text" width="1/2"][vc_column_text css=""]

MORE THAN JUST A GAME

The Golf Sanctuary isn’t your typical indoor golf course. It’s a destination where modern design, premium comfort, and advanced simulation technology converge seamlessly. From the moment you enter, you’re welcomed into a space that feels sophisticated yet inviting, with areas for relaxation, socialising, and immersive play.

For those who want to improve, our dedicated, state-of-the-art coaching and fitting space takes your practice beyond the simulator—featuring three cameras and two 42-inch touch-screen TVs that use multi-angles and interactive review that deliver clear feedback and faster progress, so you can play better and score lower.

Our state-of-the-art golf training simulator allows both beginners and seasoned golfers to refine their skills with precision, while still keeping the experience fun and accessible. Every swing, putt, and shot is designed to feel like the real thing, making your time here both effective and enjoyable. And beyond the game, the vibrant social spaces and thoughtful design encourage connection, conversation, and lasting memories.

READ MORE

PLAY YOUR WAY

Whether you're looking to improve your game or simply enjoy time with friends, The Golf Sanctuary gives you the flexibility to play how you want. Casual sessions are easy to book, while members can enjoy extended access and exclusive benefits. From simulator hire and coaching to club fitting and range sessions, our offerings are designed to suit all levels and interests.

With advanced tracking and performance feedback, dedicated golfers can work on their technique, while social players can relax and soak in the ambience. This is indoor golf reimagined — a place where serious training and enjoyable play coexist without pressure.

READ MORE

FOOD, DRINKS & SOCIAL SPACES

What sets The Golf Sanctuary apart is our full kitchen and premium beverage selection. Unlike other venues that offer only basic snacks, we provide a thoughtfully curated menu to complement your experience. From fresh, shareable plates to gourmet drinks, our food and beverage offerings transform a typical visit into a full social outing.

Enjoy a meal between rounds, toast with friends, or host a group event in style. Our spaces are designed for comfort and connection, making every visit a complete experience — not just a session on a simulator. Specialty cocktails, craft beers, and a rotating menu of chef-designed dishes ensure that every visit feels unique and indulgent.

READ MORE

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="home-img"][vc_single_image image="2712" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="about-home"][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="about-texts"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="about-text"][vc_custom_heading text="CONFIDENCE IN EVERY CLUB" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-16"][vc_custom_heading text="OFFICIAL TITLEIST PARTNER" use_theme_fonts="yes" css="" el_class="font-60"][vc_column_text css=""]Our premium hire sets feature the latest Titleist GT family, including GT2 and GT3, alongside the T-Series iron range. With options suited to a wide range of golfers — from those new to the game through to experienced players — every guest can enjoy the performance and quality expected from Titleist. Around the greens, Vokey Design SM11 wedges provide exceptional spin, control and versatility across a range of lofts.

Every simulator bay at The Golf Sanctuary is also stocked with brand new Titleist Pro V1 golf balls. For us, using generic range balls simply didn’t align with the experience we wanted to create. We’ve built The Golf Sanctuary as a premium golf destination, and we believe the equipment our guests use should reflect that — which is why we’ve chosen Titleist from tee to green.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2" el_class="home-img"][vc_single_image image="2374" img_size="full" css=""][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_class="range-row"][vc_column][vc_column_text css=""]

The Golf Sanctuary: Indoor Golf - Golf Training Simulator
Discover Australia’s premier indoor golf experience. Play iconic global courses with unmatched accuracy in a luxury sanctuary. Better tech, better atmosphere.
Indoor Golf Like No Other in Melbourne
Titleist Pro V1 in every simulator bay

Whether you’re looking to improve your game or simply enjoy time with friends, The Golf Sanctuary gives you the flexibility to play how you want. Casual sessions are easy to book, while members can enjoy extended access and exclusive benefits. From simulator hire and coaching to club fitting and range sessions, our offerings are designed to suit all levels and interests.
With advanced tracking and performance feedback, dedicated golfers can work on their technique, while social players can relax and soak in the ambience. This is indoor golf reimagined — a place where serious training and enjoyable play coexist without pressure.

Experience the ultimate indoor golf destination where technology, competition, and social fun come together. Play world-class courses, host unforgettable events, and improve your game — all in one premium space.
Parties, celebrations and team functions — with planning and catering handled by our team.
Where Golf, Community & Premium Experiences Come Together

Enjoy exclusive membership benefits while enhancing your golf skills and furthering social and business connections. As a member, you get priority bookings and all other perks! At The Golf Sanctuary, we’ll make it worth your while!
New to indoor golf? Here are the answers to the things people most often ask before their first visit.

What sets The Golf Sanctuary apart is our full kitchen and premium beverage selection. Unlike other venues that offer only basic snacks, we provide a thoughtfully curated menu to complement your experience. From fresh, shareable plates to gourmet drinks, our food and beverage offerings transform a typical visit into a full social outing.
Enjoy a meal between rounds, toast with friends, or host a group event in style. Our spaces are designed for comfort and connection, making every visit a complete experience — not just a session on a simulator. Specialty cocktails, craft beers, and a rotating menu of chef-designed dishes ensure that every visit feels unique and indulgent.
7 Trackman range bays · from $22 an hour

A standout feature of our venue is The Penthouse — our exclusive private event space purpose-built for premium group experiences.
Featuring five advanced simulators, a private bar, darts, premium lounge seating, and a stylish social layout, The Penthouse is ideal for corporate functions, team-building sessions, client entertainment, networking events, and private celebrations and milestone events.
Rack up a game between rounds

The Golf Sanctuary isn’t your typical indoor golf course. It’s a destination where modern design, premium comfort, and advanced simulation technology converge seamlessly. From the moment you enter, you’re welcomed into a space that feels sophisticated yet inviting, with areas for relaxation, socialising, and immersive play.
Designed for players of all skill levels

Planning a private event or corporate function? Our penthouse area features five simulators, a private bar, darts, and comfortable seating arrangements — perfect for hosting memorable events in a premium environment. Whether it’s team-building, celebrations, or social gatherings, The Golf Sanctuary provides a unique setting that combines entertainment, networking, and luxury.
Our professional staff can assist with planning and catering, ensuring that every detail is handled. From intimate gatherings to large corporate events, we create experiences that leave a lasting impression.
Where golf meets luxury and connection

With over 400+ world-class golf courses available, nearest-to-pin competitions, and a variety of other competitions for the serious golfer or the beginner, we can ensure your team or clients a highly entertaining experience.
For larger events of 25 guests or more, The Golf Sanctuary is proud to offer catering through our exclusive partnership with Peter Rowland Catering. Club hire is included with all event bookings.
Good food, great company, better golf
Celebrate in style with golf, fun and food
End the year in style with golf, great food & festivities

Indoor golf uses advanced simulator technology to recreate the feel of playing on a real course. Players hit premium golf balls into a screen and the Trackman hardware captures 40 different data points at thousands of frames per second to provide the most accurate information back to the player.
Suitable for all skill levels, indoor golf allows you to play full rounds, practise specific shots, or take part in coaching sessions. Thanks to the controlled indoor environment, you can enjoy a consistent, immersive golf experience year-round — no matter the weather.

Modern indoor golf simulators are highly accurate, especially when using advanced systems like TrackMan technology. By combining radar and high-speed cameras, these simulators capture detailed data on swing and ball flight, allowing distances, shot shape, and ball behaviour to closely mirror real-world conditions.
At The Golf Sanctuary, this accuracy means players can trust the feedback they receive. Experienced golfers can analyse their performance and refine their game, while beginners gain a clear, easy way to see how different swings affect the ball — one of the key reasons indoor golf continues to grow in popularity.
Is The Golf Sanctuary suitable for beginners?

The Golf Sanctuary is intentionally designed to appeal to a wide audience. While indoor golf has traditionally skewed toward young men, our space is perfect for women, families, groups, and corporate clients alike. Everyone is welcome to enjoy our inclusive, judgement-free environment, whether it’s your first swing or your hundredth round.
By combining high-tech equipment, professional instruction, and a comfortable social atmosphere, we’ve created a venue where all visitors feel at home while enjoying the excitement of indoor golf.
Do I need to be a member to play?

From casual bookings to full memberships, The Golf Sanctuary has options to suit your lifestyle. Casual sessions allow you to enjoy a flexible visit, while memberships unlock exclusive access, priority booking, and additional benefits. Combined with simulator hire, coaching, club fitting, and food and beverage options, membership is more than just convenience — it’s an enhanced experience.

Our premium hire sets feature the latest Titleist GT family, including GT2 and GT3, alongside the T-Series iron range. With options suited to a wide range of golfers — from those new to the game through to experienced players — every guest can enjoy the performance and quality expected from Titleist. Around the greens, Vokey Design SM11 wedges provide exceptional spin, control and versatility across a range of lofts.
Every simulator bay at The Golf Sanctuary is also stocked with brand new Titleist Pro V1 golf balls. For us, using generic range balls simply didn’t align with the experience we wanted to create — which is why we’ve chosen Titleist from tee to green.
What should I wear to indoor golf?

One of the advantages of indoor golf is its flexibility when it comes to dress code. Unlike traditional golf courses, there’s no strict requirement for collared shirts or specific attire.
At The Golf Sanctuary, we recommend wearing comfortable, casual clothing that allows for a full range of motion. Activewear, golf polos, t-shirts, and comfortable pants or shorts are all suitable options.
Footwear is also flexible — while golf shoes can be worn, clean sneakers are perfectly acceptable and often more convenient.
Because the environment is climate-controlled, you don’t need to worry about weather conditions. This means you can focus on your game and enjoy the experience without the usual considerations of outdoor golf.
How can I improve my golf swing?

Improving your golf swing comes down to a combination of practice, feedback, and consistency. One of the most effective ways to develop your technique is by using a simulator environment where every shot provides measurable data.
At The Golf Sanctuary, players have access to detailed swing analysis and professional coaching, making it easier to identify areas for improvement. By understanding factors like club path, face angle, and ball speed, you can make targeted adjustments that lead to real progress.
For those who want to improve, our dedicated, state-of-the-art coaching and fitting space takes your practice beyond the simulator — featuring three cameras and two 42-inch touch-screen TVs that use multi-angles and interactive review that deliver clear feedback and faster progress, so you can play better and score lower.
Regular practice is also key. Short, consistent sessions are often more effective than occasional long ones, as they help build muscle memory and reinforce good habits. For those looking to accelerate their improvement, lessons with a PGA professional can provide structured guidance and personalised feedback.
Where is The Golf Sanctuary located?

Located just off Dandenong Road, around the corner from Monash University, and directly across from M-City Shopping Centre, The Golf Sanctuary is designed for convenience. Whether it’s a casual drop-in, a night out with friends, or a corporate event, getting here is easy — and once you’re inside, you’ll quickly see why this isn’t just another golf studio. Find us at a1/1866 Dandenong Rd, Clayton VIC 3168 We’re open Monday to Sunday, 7am – 10pm.

Our Golf Leagues will start in February and will have some of the best prizes available in Australia. There will be various golf leagues for both men and women including Individual, 2 Person Teams and 3 Person Teams. Please register your interest below and we will be in touch in January.
Fill in your details and we will be in touch in January.
